DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-TENRI-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-TENRI-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。今日はどのようなご用件でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-TENRI-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. What brings you here today?

DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-TENRI-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-TENRI-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 税の通知が届きました。勤務先の書類と金額が違うので、相談に来ました。
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-TENRI-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 通知と勤務先の書類の金額が違うため相談に来たと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-TENRI-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: I received a tax notice. Its amount differs from my employer's document, so I've come for advice.
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-TENRI-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you're here because the notice and employer document show different amounts. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-TENRI-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-TENRI-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 通知を拝見します。こちらは市役所が発行した住民税の通知ですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-TENRI-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: Let me see the notice. This is a resident-tax notice issued by city hall.

DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-TENRI-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-TENRI-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 税務署ではなく、市役所に相談するのですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-TENRI-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 相談先が税務署ではなく市役所か確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-TENRI-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: So I should consult city hall rather than the national tax office?
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-TENRI-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Confirm the consultation destination is city hall, not the tax office. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-TENRI-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-TENRI-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: はい、この通知の相談先は、下に印刷された市役所の窓口です。
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-TENRI-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: Yes, for this notice it's the city hall counter printed below.

DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-TENRI-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-TENRI-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 電話番号が二つあります。金額のことを聞くなら、どちらにかけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-TENRI-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 二つの電話番号のうち、金額について相談する番号を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-TENRI-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: There are two phone numbers. Which do I call to ask about the amount?
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-TENRI-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask which of the two numbers is for discussing the amount. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-TENRI-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-TENRI-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 金額については、こちらの「課税内容の問い合わせ」の番号です。
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-TENRI-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: For the amount, this is the number labeled inquiries about assessment details.

DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-TENRI-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-TENRI-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: こちらですね。電話では、通知のどの番号を伝えればよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-TENRI-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 案内された番号を確認し、電話で伝える通知上の番号を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-TENRI-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: This one, then. Which number on the notice should I give over the phone?
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-TENRI-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Confirm the contact number and ask which notice number to state on the phone. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-TENRI-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-TENRI-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: この通知番号をお手元に置いてください。勤務先の書類も見ながら、ご事情を伝えるとよいでしょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-TENRI-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: Keep this notice number ready. It helps to explain your circumstances while looking at your employer's document too.

DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-TENRI-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-TENRI-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 通知番号と勤務先の書類を用意して、この問い合わせ先に電話します。
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-TENRI-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 通知番号と勤務先の書類を用意して案内先に電話すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-TENRI-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll have the notice number and employer document ready and call this contact.
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-TENRI-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Prepare the notice number and employer document and say you'll call the indicated contact. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-TENRI-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-TENRI-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: はい、通知もお持ち帰りください。お気をつけてお帰りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-TENRI-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Yes, take the notice home too. Take care on your way home.

DLG-SC-NAR-YOSHINO-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-NAR-YOSHINO-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 散歩のご相談ですか。今日は山道にぬかるみが残っています。
DLG-SC-NAR-YOSHINO-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you asking about a walk? The mountain paths are still muddy today.

DLG-SC-NAR-YOSHINO-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-NAR-YOSHINO-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 一時間ほど歩きたいのですが、運動靴で行ける道はありますか。
DLG-SC-NAR-YOSHINO-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 時間と靴の条件に合う道を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-NAR-YOSHINO-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'd like to walk for about an hour. Is there a path suitable for sneakers?
DLG-SC-NAR-YOSHINO-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask for a route matching your time and footwear. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-NAR-YOSHINO-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-NAR-YOSHINO-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 川沿いの舗装路なら、ここから往復四十分ほどです。途中に屋根のある休憩所もあります。
DLG-SC-NAR-YOSHINO-001-SHARED-03.translation: The paved riverside path takes about forty minutes round trip from here. There's a sheltered rest area along it too.

DLG-SC-NAR-YOSHINO-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-NAR-YOSHINO-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 川沿いにします。どこで折り返せばいいですか。
DLG-SC-NAR-YOSHINO-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 川沿いを選び折り返す地点を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-NAR-YOSHINO-001-SHARED-04.translation: I'll take the riverside path. Where should I turn back?
DLG-SC-NAR-YOSHINO-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Choose the riverside and ask the turning point. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-NAR-YOSHINO-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-NAR-YOSHINO-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: この橋の手前で折り返してください。その先は舗装が途切れます。
DLG-SC-NAR-YOSHINO-001-SHARED-05.translation: Turn back before this bridge. The pavement ends beyond it.

DLG-SC-NAR-YOSHINO-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-NAR-YOSHINO-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 橋の手前ですね。途中で雨が降ったら、休憩所から小屋に戻れますか。
DLG-SC-NAR-YOSHINO-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 折り返す地点を確認し雨天時の帰路を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-NAR-YOSHINO-001-SHARED-06.translation: Before the bridge, then. If it rains on the way, can I return from the rest area to the hut?
DLG-SC-NAR-YOSHINO-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Confirm the turning point and ask about returning in rain. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-NAR-YOSHINO-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-NAR-YOSHINO-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: この横道で戻れますが、階段があります。段差のない帰り道なら、来た道を戻ってください。
DLG-SC-NAR-YOSHINO-001-SHARED-07.translation: You can use this side path, but it has stairs. For a step-free return, retrace your route.

DLG-SC-NAR-YOSHINO-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-NAR-YOSHINO-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 足元が気になるので、来た道で戻ります。地図を一枚もらえますか。
DLG-SC-NAR-YOSHINO-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 段差を避ける帰路を選び地図を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-NAR-YOSHINO-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'm concerned about footing, so I'll come back the same way. Could I have a map?
DLG-SC-NAR-YOSHINO-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Choose the return route avoiding steps and request a map. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-NAR-YOSHINO-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-NAR-YOSHINO-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: どうぞ。青い線が舗装路で、丸印が休憩所です。
DLG-SC-NAR-YOSHINO-001-SHARED-09.translation: Here you are. The blue line is paved, and the circle is the rest area.

DLG-SC-NAR-YOSHINO-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-NAR-YOSHINO-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。休憩を入れて、三時までに戻ってきます。
DLG-SC-NAR-YOSHINO-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 休憩を含む帰着予定を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-NAR-YOSHINO-001-SHARED-10.translation: Thank you. Including a rest, I'll be back by three.
DLG-SC-NAR-YOSHINO-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Give your planned return including a rest. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-NAR-YOSHINO-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-NAR-YOSHINO-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: お気をつけて。いってらっしゃい。

DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-YOSHINO-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-YOSHINO-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: ふたを載せてみてください。角に引っかかるところはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-YOSHINO-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: Try placing the lid on. Does it catch at any corner?

DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-YOSHINO-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-YOSHINO-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 右の角が引っかかって、最後まで閉まりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-YOSHINO-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 引っかかる位置と閉まらない状態を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-YOSHINO-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: It catches at the right corner and won't close fully.
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-YOSHINO-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Describe where it catches and the failure to close. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-YOSHINO-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-YOSHINO-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: ここに鉛筆で印を付けます。この印の内側を、紙やすりで少しずつ削りましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-YOSHINO-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: I'll mark here in pencil. Let's sand gradually inside this mark.

DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-YOSHINO-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-YOSHINO-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: この粗い紙やすりでいいですか。それとも細かいほうを使いますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-YOSHINO-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 使う紙やすりの種類を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-YOSHINO-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: Should I use this coarse sandpaper or the finer one?
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-YOSHINO-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ask which type of sandpaper to use. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-YOSHINO-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-YOSHINO-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 細かいほうです。削りすぎないように、数回こすったら合わせてみてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-YOSHINO-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: The finer one. To avoid removing too much, test the fit after a few strokes.

DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-YOSHINO-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-YOSHINO-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 三回こすりました。もう一度ふたを載せてみます。
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-YOSHINO-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 削った回数と試す行動を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-YOSHINO-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: I've rubbed it three times. I'll place the lid on again.
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-YOSHINO-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: State the number of sanding strokes and that you'll test it. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-YOSHINO-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-YOSHINO-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: さっきより入りましたね。まだ右の角だけ少し当たっています。
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-YOSHINO-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: It goes farther than before. Only the right corner still touches a little.

DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-YOSHINO-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-YOSHINO-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 右の角だけ、もう二回こすってみます。
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-YOSHINO-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 当たる角だけ追加で削ると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-YOSHINO-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll give just the right corner two more strokes.
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-YOSHINO-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you'll sand only the touching corner a little more. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-YOSHINO-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-YOSHINO-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: これで閉まりますね。最後に、鉛筆の印を消しゴムで消してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-YOSHINO-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: Now it closes. Finally, erase the pencil mark.

DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-YOSHINO-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-YOSHINO-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 印も取れました。木の香りがするので、机で使うのが楽しみです。
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-YOSHINO-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 仕上がりと使う予定を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-YOSHINO-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: The mark's gone too. I can smell the wood; I'm looking forward to using it on my desk.
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-YOSHINO-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Describe the finished result and intended use. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-YOSHINO-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-YOSHINO-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: お持ち帰りの袋はこちらです。ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-YOSHINO-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Here's a bag to take it home. Thank you.

DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-YOSHINO-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-YOSHINO-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: いらっしゃいませ。ご予約のお名前を伺えますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-YOSHINO-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: Welcome. May I have the booking name?

DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-YOSHINO-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-YOSHINO-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: リンです。今日から一泊で予約しています。
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-YOSHINO-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 予約名と泊数を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-YOSHINO-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: Linh. I have a one-night reservation starting today.
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-YOSHINO-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Give your reservation name and number of nights. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-YOSHINO-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-YOSHINO-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: リン様ですね。夕食は六時と六時半のどちらになさいますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-YOSHINO-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: Linh, yes. Would you like dinner at six or six thirty?

DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-YOSHINO-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-YOSHINO-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 少し休みたいので、六時半にお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-YOSHINO-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 夕食の時間を選ぶ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-YOSHINO-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: I'd like a little rest first, so six thirty, please.
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-YOSHINO-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Choose your dinner time. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-YOSHINO-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-YOSHINO-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 承知しました。お部屋は二階ですが、お荷物をお運びしましょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-YOSHINO-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: Certainly. Your room is on the second floor; shall we carry your luggage?

DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-YOSHINO-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-YOSHINO-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: この大きいかばんをお願いできますか。小さいほうは自分で持ちます。
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-YOSHINO-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 運んでもらう荷物を指定する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-YOSHINO-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: Could you take this large bag? I'll carry the small one myself.
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-YOSHINO-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Specify which luggage you'd like carried. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-YOSHINO-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-YOSHINO-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 大きいかばんをお預かりします。夕食会場は一階の奥です。
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-YOSHINO-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: I'll take the large bag. Dinner is at the back of the first floor.

DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-YOSHINO-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-YOSHINO-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 食事に行くとき、部屋の鍵は受付に預けますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-YOSHINO-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 館内での鍵の扱いを尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-YOSHINO-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: Should I leave the room key at reception when going to eat?
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-YOSHINO-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask about key handling inside the building. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-YOSHINO-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-YOSHINO-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 館内ではお持ちください。外へお出かけになるときは、こちらでお預かりします。
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-YOSHINO-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: Keep it with you indoors. We'll hold it here when you go outside.

DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-YOSHINO-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-YOSHINO-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: わかりました。鍵を持って、六時半に一階へ行きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-YOSHINO-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 鍵の扱いと夕食場所を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-YOSHINO-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: Understood. I'll take the key and go to the first floor at six thirty.
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-YOSHINO-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm the key handling and dinner location. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-YOSHINO-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-YOSHINO-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では、お部屋へご案内します。ごゆっくりお過ごしください。
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-YOSHINO-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: I'll show you to your room. Enjoy your stay.

DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-YOSHINO-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-YOSHINO-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 今日は前髪を整えるご予約ですね。どのくらい切りましょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-YOSHINO-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: You're booked for a fringe trim today. How much shall I cut?

DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-YOSHINO-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-YOSHINO-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 眉が少し見えるくらいにしたいです。短くしすぎないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-YOSHINO-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 前髪の希望の長さを伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-YOSHINO-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'd like my eyebrows just a little visible. Please don't make it too short.
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-YOSHINO-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Give your preferred fringe length. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-YOSHINO-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-YOSHINO-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: まず眉の下まで切って、鏡で見ていただきます。前髪だけでしたら千円です。
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-YOSHINO-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: I'll cut to below the eyebrows first and let you check in the mirror. Fringe-only is 1,000 yen.

DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-YOSHINO-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-YOSHINO-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: それでお願いします。普段は右へ流しています。
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-YOSHINO-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 料金を了承し普段の流し方を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-YOSHINO-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: That's fine. I usually sweep it to the right.
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-YOSHINO-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Accept the price and explain your usual sweep direction. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-YOSHINO-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-YOSHINO-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 右へ流した状態で長さを合わせますね。分け目はこちらでよろしいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-YOSHINO-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: I'll match the length with it swept right. Is this parting correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-YOSHINO-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-YOSHINO-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: はい、この分け目でお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-YOSHINO-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 分け目を指定する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-YOSHINO-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Specify the parting. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-YOSHINO-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-YOSHINO-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 一度この長さで見てください。眉に少しかかっていますね。
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-YOSHINO-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: Check this length first. It's slightly over the eyebrows.

DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-YOSHINO-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-YOSHINO-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 真ん中だけ、あと少し短くできますか。横はこのまま残したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-YOSHINO-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 真ん中だけ短くするよう頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-YOSHINO-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: Could you shorten just the middle a little more? I'd like the sides left as they are.
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-YOSHINO-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask to shorten only the middle. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-YOSHINO-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-YOSHINO-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 真ん中を二ミリほど切りました。右へ流してみると、いかがですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-YOSHINO-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: I've cut about two millimeters in the center. How is it swept right?

DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-YOSHINO-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-YOSHINO-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: ちょうどいいです。これなら家でも同じように流せそうです。
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-YOSHINO-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 仕上がりへの満足を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-YOSHINO-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: Just right. I think I can style it the same way at home.
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-YOSHINO-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Express satisfaction with the result. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-YOSHINO-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-YOSHINO-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では、切った髪を払いますね。本日はありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-YOSHINO-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: I'll brush off the cut hair now. Thank you for coming today.

DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-YOSHINO-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-YOSHINO-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こちらの地図をご覧ですか。どこへ行かれる予定でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-YOSHINO-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you looking at this map? Where do you plan to go?

DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-YOSHINO-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-YOSHINO-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 杉の器を買ってから、景色を見に行きたいです。順番を相談できますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-YOSHINO-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 買い物と景色を見る順番を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-YOSHINO-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'd like to buy a cedar vessel, then see the scenery. Can I ask about the order of those visits?
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-YOSHINO-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Discuss the order of shopping and sightseeing. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-YOSHINO-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-YOSHINO-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 器を持って上り坂を歩くことになります。先に展望場所へ行って、帰りに買い物をする方法もあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-YOSHINO-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: That would mean walking uphill carrying the vessel. You could visit the viewpoint first and shop on the way back.

DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-YOSHINO-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-YOSHINO-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 土産店で先に器を選びたいです。買った荷物を預けられる所はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-YOSHINO-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 先に買い物をしたいと伝え荷物預かりを尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-YOSHINO-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: I'd like to choose the vessel at the souvenir shop first. Is there somewhere to leave purchased luggage?
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-YOSHINO-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say you'd like to shop first and ask about luggage storage. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-YOSHINO-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-YOSHINO-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: この案内所でお預かりできます。一つ三百円で、四時までにお戻りいただきます。
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-YOSHINO-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: We can hold it at this information center: 300 yen per item, collected by four.

DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-YOSHINO-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-YOSHINO-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 四時までですね。割れ物でも預けられますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-YOSHINO-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 引取時刻を確認し割れ物の扱いを尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-YOSHINO-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: By four, then. Can you hold breakables too?
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-YOSHINO-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Confirm collection time and ask about fragile items. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-YOSHINO-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-YOSHINO-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 箱に入った物ならお預かりします。店で箱に入れてもらってください。
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-YOSHINO-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: If boxed, yes. Ask the shop to put it in a box.

DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-YOSHINO-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-YOSHINO-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 箱入りで持ってきます。展望場所へはどの道を使いますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-YOSHINO-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 梱包方法を了承し展望場所への道を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-YOSHINO-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll bring it boxed. Which path goes to the viewpoint?
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-YOSHINO-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Accept the packing method and ask the route to the viewpoint. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-YOSHINO-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-YOSHINO-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: この赤い線の坂道です。帰りも同じ道なので、案内所に寄ってから駅へ向かえます。
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-YOSHINO-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: This uphill path marked red. You'll return the same way, so you can stop at the center before heading to the station.

DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-YOSHINO-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-YOSHINO-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: では、買い物をしてここへ戻ります。預けるときに三百円払いますね。
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-YOSHINO-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 買い物後の行動と支払いを確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-YOSHINO-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: Then I'll shop and come back here. I'll pay 300 yen when leaving the item, right?
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-YOSHINO-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm your actions after shopping and payment. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-YOSHINO-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-YOSHINO-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: はい、こちらの窓口へお越しください。いってらっしゃい。
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-YOSHINO-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Yes, come to this counter. Enjoy your outing.

DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-YOSHINO-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-YOSHINO-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 忘れ物のお問い合わせですね。何をお忘れになりましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-YOSHINO-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: You're asking about lost property. What did you leave behind?

DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-YOSHINO-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-YOSHINO-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 茶色の帽子です。さっき着いた列車の座席に置いたと思います。
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-YOSHINO-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 忘れ物の種類と置いた場所を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-YOSHINO-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: A brown hat. I think I left it on the seat of the train that just arrived.
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-YOSHINO-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Give the lost item's type and where you left it. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-YOSHINO-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-YOSHINO-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 何時ごろ到着した列車でしょうか。座っていた場所も覚えていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-YOSHINO-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: Around what time did the train arrive? Do you remember where you sat?

DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-YOSHINO-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-YOSHINO-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 二時ごろです。一番前の車両の、右側の席でした。
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-YOSHINO-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 列車の到着時刻と座席位置を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-YOSHINO-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: About two. In the front carriage, on the right-hand seats.
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-YOSHINO-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain the train's arrival time and seat location. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-YOSHINO-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-YOSHINO-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 茶色の帽子が一つ届いています。内側に何か目印はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-YOSHINO-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: One brown hat has been handed in. Any identifying mark inside?

DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-YOSHINO-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-YOSHINO-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 内側に白い糸で、リンと名前を縫ってあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-YOSHINO-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 本人の物と照合できる目印を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-YOSHINO-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: The name Linh is sewn inside with white thread.
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-YOSHINO-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Give an identifying mark for ownership matching. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-YOSHINO-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-YOSHINO-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 名前が一致していますね。受け取りの記録に、お名前と連絡先をご記入ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-YOSHINO-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: The name matches. Please fill in your name and contact details on the collection record.

DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-YOSHINO-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-YOSHINO-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: ここに携帯電話の番号を書けばいいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-YOSHINO-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 記入する連絡先を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-YOSHINO-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: Should I write my mobile number here?
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-YOSHINO-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Confirm which contact information to enter. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-YOSHINO-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-YOSHINO-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい。ご記入後、こちらの帽子がお客様の物かご覧ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-YOSHINO-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes. After writing, check whether this hat is yours.

DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-YOSHINO-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-YOSHINO-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 私の帽子です。見つけてくださって、ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-YOSHINO-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 帽子を確認し礼を述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-YOSHINO-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: It is mine. Thank you for finding it.
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-YOSHINO-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Identify the hat and express thanks. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-YOSHINO-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-YOSHINO-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: お渡ししますね。お気をつけてお帰りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-YOSHINO-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: Here you are. Take care on your way home.

DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-YOSHINO-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-YOSHINO-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 散歩用のバッグをお探しですか。どんな物を入れますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-YOSHINO-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you looking for a walking bag? What will you put in it?

DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-YOSHINO-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-YOSHINO-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 五百ミリリットルの水筒と携帯電話です。両手を空けて歩きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-YOSHINO-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 入れる物と両手を空けたい希望を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-YOSHINO-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: A 500-milliliter water bottle and my phone. I'd like to walk with both hands free.
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-YOSHINO-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Give the contents and desire to keep your hands free. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-YOSHINO-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-YOSHINO-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 腰に付けるこちらはいかがでしょうか。水筒を入れて試せます。
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-YOSHINO-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: How about this waist bag? You can test it with your bottle.

DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-YOSHINO-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-YOSHINO-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: この水筒を入れてみてもいいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-YOSHINO-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 持参の水筒を入れて試す許可を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-YOSHINO-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: May I try putting this bottle in?
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-YOSHINO-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ask permission to test with your own bottle. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-YOSHINO-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-YOSHINO-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: どうぞ。ふたまで収まったら、ベルトを腰に合わせてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-YOSHINO-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please do. Once the bottle fits including its lid, adjust the belt to your waist.

DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-YOSHINO-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-YOSHINO-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 入りました。ベルトが少し余るのですが、短くできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-YOSHINO-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 収まりを伝えベルトの調整を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-YOSHINO-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: It's in. There's a little excess belt; can it be shortened?
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-YOSHINO-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Report the fit and ask about belt adjustment. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-YOSHINO-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-YOSHINO-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: この留め具で調整できます。余った部分はこちらの輪に通してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-YOSHINO-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: Adjust it with this buckle. Pass the excess through this loop.

DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-YOSHINO-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-YOSHINO-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 歩いても揺れにくいですね。黒い物もありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-YOSHINO-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 使用感を伝え黒の在庫を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-YOSHINO-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: It doesn't swing much when walking. Do you also have black?
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-YOSHINO-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Describe its feel and ask for black stock. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-YOSHINO-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-YOSHINO-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい、黒もあります。お値段は三千二百円です。
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-YOSHINO-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes, black is available. It's 3,200 yen.

DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-YOSHINO-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-YOSHINO-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 黒を一つ買います。水筒は出して、袋に入れてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-YOSHINO-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 色と購入数を決め包装を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-YOSHINO-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll buy one black bag. Please remove the bottle and bag it.
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-YOSHINO-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Choose color and quantity and request packaging. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-YOSHINO-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-YOSHINO-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました、レジへどうぞ。ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-YOSHINO-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Certainly, please come to the register. Thank you.

DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-YOSHINO-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-YOSHINO-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 申込書で、書き方がわからない所はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-YOSHINO-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Any parts of the application you don't know how to fill in?

DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-YOSHINO-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-YOSHINO-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 勤務先の欄です。派遣会社と、実際に働く木工所のどちらを書きますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-YOSHINO-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 派遣会社と就業先のどちらを記入するか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-YOSHINO-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: The workplace field. Should I write the staffing agency or the woodworking shop where I actually work?
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-YOSHINO-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether to enter the staffing agency or worksite. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-YOSHINO-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-YOSHINO-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 雇用されている会社名を書いていただきます。雇用契約書など、確認できる物はお持ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-YOSHINO-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: Enter the name of the company employing you. Do you have an employment contract or something to check?

DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-YOSHINO-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-YOSHINO-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 派遣会社からもらった雇用契約書があります。これを見てもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-YOSHINO-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 雇用契約書を提示し確認を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-YOSHINO-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: I have the employment contract from the agency. Could you look at it?
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-YOSHINO-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Present the employment contract and request checking. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-YOSHINO-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-YOSHINO-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 拝見します。こちらの会社名と所在地を、勤務先の欄へお書きください。
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-YOSHINO-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let me see. Write this company name and address in the workplace field.

DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-YOSHINO-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-YOSHINO-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 電話番号も派遣会社の番号でいいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-YOSHINO-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 記入する電話番号を確かめる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-YOSHINO-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: Should the phone number also be the agency's?
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-YOSHINO-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Confirm the phone number to enter. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-YOSHINO-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-YOSHINO-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: はい、そちらをご記入ください。給与を受け取る予定日も伺えますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-YOSHINO-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: Yes, enter that. May I also ask your planned payday?

DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-YOSHINO-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-YOSHINO-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 初めての給与は来月の十日です。それまでに口座ができるか気になっています。
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-YOSHINO-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 給与日と開設時期への懸念を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-YOSHINO-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: My first pay is on the tenth next month. I'm worried whether the account will be ready by then.
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-YOSHINO-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Give payday and concern about account-opening timing. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-YOSHINO-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-YOSHINO-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 開設には書類確認と審査があるため、お約束はできません。申込みの連絡先は、この携帯番号でよろしいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-YOSHINO-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: Opening requires document checks and screening, so we can't promise. Is this mobile number correct for contacting you about the application?

DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-YOSHINO-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-YOSHINO-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい、その番号でお願いします。勤務先の欄を書いたら提出します。
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-YOSHINO-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 連絡先を確認し申込書を提出すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-YOSHINO-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes, that number, please. I'll submit after filling in the workplace field.
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-YOSHINO-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm the contact and say you'll submit the application. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-YOSHINO-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-YOSHINO-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: お書きになったらお声がけください。本日はご来店ありがとうございます。
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-YOSHINO-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Let us know when you've written it. Thank you for visiting today.

DLG-SC-NGN-KARUIZAWA-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-NGN-KARUIZAWA-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お急ぎのようですが、何かお困りでしょうか。
DLG-SC-NGN-KARUIZAWA-001-SHARED-01.translation: You seem in a hurry. Is anything wrong?

DLG-SC-NGN-KARUIZAWA-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-NGN-KARUIZAWA-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: ここまで車で来て、少し気分が悪くなりました。乗り物に酔いやすいので、新幹線に乗る前に休みたいです。
DLG-SC-NGN-KARUIZAWA-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 車移動後に気分が悪く乗車前に休む場所を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-NGN-KARUIZAWA-001-SHARED-02.translation: I came here by car and started feeling a little unwell. I get motion sickness easily, so I'd like to rest before taking the shinkansen.
DLG-SC-NGN-KARUIZAWA-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain you feel unwell after car travel and ask for somewhere to rest before boarding. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-NGN-KARUIZAWA-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-NGN-KARUIZAWA-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 今、歩くことはできそうですか。こちらでいったん立ち止まり、休める場所をご案内します。
DLG-SC-NGN-KARUIZAWA-001-SHARED-03.translation: Do you feel able to walk now? Stop here for a moment, and we'll show you somewhere to rest.

DLG-SC-NGN-KARUIZAWA-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-NGN-KARUIZAWA-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: ゆっくりなら歩けます。吐いてはいませんが、荷物を持って急ぐとつらいです。列車に間に合うことだけ考えていました。
DLG-SC-NGN-KARUIZAWA-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 歩ける状態と荷物を持って急ぐつらさを説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-NGN-KARUIZAWA-001-SHARED-04.translation: I can walk slowly. I haven't vomited, but rushing with luggage is hard. I was thinking only of catching the train.
DLG-SC-NGN-KARUIZAWA-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain your ability to walk and difficulty hurrying with luggage. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-NGN-KARUIZAWA-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-NGN-KARUIZAWA-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 急がずにご案内を受けてください。ご同行の方はいらっしゃいますか。
DLG-SC-NGN-KARUIZAWA-001-SHARED-05.translation: Don't rush; let us guide you. Is anyone traveling with you?

DLG-SC-NGN-KARUIZAWA-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-NGN-KARUIZAWA-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 友達が先にホームへ行っています。私を待つために列車のドアの所に立たず、いったん係員に相談してほしいと連絡します。
DLG-SC-NGN-KARUIZAWA-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 先にホームへ行った友達へ状況と係員への相談を伝えると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-NGN-KARUIZAWA-001-SHARED-06.translation: My friend went ahead to the platform. I'll tell them not to stand at the train door waiting for me, but to speak to staff first.
DLG-SC-NGN-KARUIZAWA-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you'll inform your friend already on the platform and ask them to consult staff. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-NGN-KARUIZAWA-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-NGN-KARUIZAWA-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: お友達へ状況を知らせてください。お持ちの切符についても、乗車を変更する必要があるか担当が確認します。
DLG-SC-NGN-KARUIZAWA-001-SHARED-07.translation: Let your friend know. Staff will also check whether your ticket needs a travel change.

DLG-SC-NGN-KARUIZAWA-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-NGN-KARUIZAWA-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: お願いします。今の切符で後の列車へそのまま乗れるとは決めず、まず休んでから相談します。
DLG-SC-NGN-KARUIZAWA-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 後続列車で切符を使えると決めず休んでから確認すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-NGN-KARUIZAWA-001-SHARED-08.translation: Please do. I won't assume this ticket lets me board a later train unchanged; I'll rest first, then ask.
DLG-SC-NGN-KARUIZAWA-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Don't assume the ticket works on a later train; say you'll rest and then check. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-NGN-KARUIZAWA-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-NGN-KARUIZAWA-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 体調が変わったり、歩くのが難しくなったりしたら、すぐにお知らせください。
DLG-SC-NGN-KARUIZAWA-001-SHARED-09.translation: If your condition changes or walking becomes difficult, tell us immediately.

DLG-SC-NGN-KARUIZAWA-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-NGN-KARUIZAWA-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 分かりました。無理にホームへ急がず、案内された場所で休みます。友達にも、自分の様子と待つ場所を伝えます。
DLG-SC-NGN-KARUIZAWA-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 無理に急がず休む場所と自分の様子を友達へ知らせると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-NGN-KARUIZAWA-001-SHARED-10.translation: Understood. I won't force myself to hurry to the platform; I'll rest where you show me. I'll tell my friend my condition and where I'm waiting too.
DLG-SC-NGN-KARUIZAWA-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you won't rush, will rest, and will tell your friend your condition and waiting location. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-NGN-KARUIZAWA-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-NGN-KARUIZAWA-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では、休める場所までご案内します。どうぞ無理をなさらず、お大事になさってください。
DLG-SC-NGN-KARUIZAWA-001-SHARED-11.translation: I'll take you somewhere to rest. Please don't push yourself; take care.
